class.name: CgameLipSync
class.brief_description: Text-driven lip sync with English and Russian rules.
class.description: [CgameLipSync] converts text to phonemes with a rule-based grapheme-to-phoneme pass (English, and Russian for Cyrillic words or [code]language = "ru"[/code]), maps phonemes to the visemes [code]A[/code] to [code]H[/code] plus [code]X[/code] (rest), builds a viseme timeline that fits a given duration, optionally refines it from an audio amplitude envelope, and samples it with smooth transitions. A timeline is an [Array] of dictionaries with [code]time[/code], [code]viseme[/code] and [code]weight[/code]. Use the output of [method sample] as the [code]viseme_weights[/code] of [method CgameFacialAnimation.evaluate].

method.name: amplitude_track
method.description: Returns the RMS envelope of mono samples, one value per hop.

method.name: phonemes_from_text
method.description: Converts text to phonemes, with [code]sil[/code] between words.

method.name: refine_with_audio
method.description: Forces rest where the envelope is silent and scales open vowels by loudness.

method.name: sample
method.description: Returns viseme weights at [param time], cross-fading over 70 ms before each key.

method.name: timeline
method.description: Builds a timeline for [param text] spoken over [param duration_seconds]. It starts and ends with rest.

method.name: viseme_for
method.description: Returns the viseme of a phoneme, or [code]X[/code] if unknown.

constants.constant: Relative envelope level below which a key becomes rest.
Minimum time between two non-bilabial keys.
